Claim 1 (Currently amended): A wire container, comprising: a housing consisting essentially of a recyclable material, the housing comprising: a peripheral wall defining a boundary leading from a first end to a second end of the housing; a plurality of end portions of the housing folded inwardly across the boundary at the second end to define an end wall, wherein the plurality of end portions comprises a plurality of triangular folds; and a plurality of support structures coplanar with and coupled to the end wall and extending across the plurality of end portions.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): A welding wire and container assembly, comprising: a housing consisting essentially of a recyclable material, the housing comprising: a cylindrical wall having a first end and a second end, wherein the cylindrical wall comprises a plurality of triangular portions folded radially inward at the second end to define an end wall; a support structure coupled to the plurality of triangular portions to provide a layered end assembly; and a coil of welding wire disposed in the housing and supported by the support structure, wherein the support structure comprises a base that is laminated with the plurality of triangular portions. 

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The assembly of claim 12, wherein the triangular portions generally meet at a central axis located within the cylindrical wall. 

Claim 19 (Currently amended): A welding wire container, comprising: a recyclable cylinder comprising a laminated base, wherein the laminated base comprises a plurality of end portions of the recyclable cylinder folded inwardly toward a central region of the recyclable cylinder to define an end wall. 

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The container of claim 19, wherein the plurality of end portions comprises triangular folds.
